EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Set shared context and preferences that apply to every project in this workspace.
PROJECT_EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Add context that only this project needs. Keep it alongside team knowledge or replace the team version for this project.
EDITOR_HELP: Use plain language. Include durable facts, audience, tone, preferences, and rules that should stay consistent.
EDITOR_FAQ_TITLE: Give Arclayer your team's shared context
EDITOR_FAQ_DESCRIPTION: Keep the product background, writing preferences, and durable rules that should guide every project in one place. Every project uses this shared knowledge as soon as it is saved.
EDITOR_FAQ_BUSINESS_ANSWER: Add shared context that should shape many projects over time, such as product positioning, audience, core use cases, and business boundaries. Keep one-off task requests in the relevant project or conversation.
EDITOR_FAQ_VOICE_QUESTION: How should I write it so Arclayer uses it well?
EDITOR_FAQ_VOICE_ANSWER: Use direct, specific language. State both what to do and what to avoid, with examples where useful—such as the default language, tone, preferred terms, and prohibited wording.
EDITOR_FAQ_RULES_QUESTION: Which rules should become team defaults?
EDITOR_FAQ_RULES_ANSWER: Include durable rules every project should follow, such as compliance requirements, content boundaries, brand voice, or technical conventions. Keep delivery-specific instructions with the work they belong to.
EDITOR_FAQ_PROJECTS_QUESTION: How does it affect existing projects?
EDITOR_FAQ_PROJECTS_ANSWER: Once saved, workspace knowledge becomes shared context for every project. Projects can still add their own instructions; those instructions replace the team version only when replacement is explicitly selected.
EDITOR_FAQ_SAVE_ANSWER: Saving applies the new content right away; the next AI task uses it. If something turns out wrong, edit the content and save again.
EDITOR_FAQ_UPDATES_QUESTION: How often should we update it?
EDITOR_FAQ_UPDATES_ANSWER: Update it when positioning, audiences, brand voice, or long-term rules change. Removing outdated or duplicated guidance usually produces more consistent results than continually adding new instructions.
EDITOR_PLACEHOLDER: Add the context and preferences you want Arclayer to remember...
